crew.overview: A stage director and an actress struggle through a grueling, coast-to-coast divorce that pushes them to their personal extremes.
crew.title: Marriage Story

details.biography: Anthony is a Lithuanian, Polish, Mexican from the San Gabriel Valley. Anthony has trained and performed around LA County as well as in NYC. Theatre: Directed by Steven Berkoff in the 2016 Odyssey Theatre Ensemble production of Eugene O'Neills' The Hairy Ape. Came back in 2018 as 'The Actor' in Steam Bath, where Paul Rodriguez was God. And then got the hat trick with The Serpent in 2019, 2 official performances right up until lock-down, where Anthony got to be a tree AND a serpent. He has been an active member of the now national Playground(LA) for 6 seasons. Recent Credit: The Lurker in 'Run Sweetheart Run'. Anthony also really loathes talking about himself in third person and yet here we are.
details.name: Anthony Rutowicz
